Job Description:

Strong foundation in machine learning, deep learning, and computer science.
Expertise in generative AI models and techniques (e.g., GANs, VAEs, Transformers).

Knowledge of advanced programming like Python, and especially AI-centric libraries like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Keras. This includes the ability to implement and manipulate complex algorithms fundamental to developing generative AI models.

Experience in Data management, including data pre-processing, augmentation, and generation of synthetic data. This involves cleaning, labeling, and augmenting data to train and improve AI models.
Experience in developing and deploying AI models in production environments.
Knowledge of cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP) and understanding of containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes for deploying , managing and scaling AI solutions

As an AI Engineer - SAP Senior Associate, you will specialize in utilizing and managing SAP software and solutions within an organization. You will be responsible for tasks such as installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of SAP products and technologies. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions.


In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of our Business Application Consulting team, specializing within our Advisory practice. You will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications. This opportunity allows you to develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, using critical thinking to break down complex concepts and generate new ideas. You will uphold professional and technical standards, using a broad range of tools and methodologies to deliver impactful solutions.


Responsibilities


- Analyzing client needs to implement and support SAP software solutions effectively
- Managing installation, configuration, and administration of SAP products and technologies
- Developing and executing strategic technology plans to optimize business application performance
- Collaborating with clients to facilitate seamless integration and utilization of SAP solutions
- Utilizing SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori to enhance data visualization and reporting capabilities
- Applying Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) for custom SAP development projects
- Leading business transformation initiatives through process improvement and optimization
- Navigating complex situations to build meaningful client relationships and deliver quality outcomes
- Mentoring junior team members to foster growth and technical skill development
- Interpreting data to inform insights and strategic recommendations for clients


What You Must Have


- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 2 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

Job Summary

Build LLM-powered agentic systems and RAG pipelines that turn football data into intelligence - taking AI systems from prototype to production.


Responsibilities

Build and integrate LLM-powered agentic systems, including tool use, function calling, structured outputs, and multi-step reasoning workflows.
Design RAG pipelines using embeddings, vector search, semantic retrieval, and football data interpretation.
Build AI/ML capabilities exposed through REST APIs and backend services.
Evaluate and improve model quality, reliability, latency, and cost.
Work closely with Engineering and Product to take AI systems from prototype to production.
Debug imperfect data, failure cases, and system behaviour across AI and backend workflows.
Stay up-to-date with developments in LLMs, machine learning, and football analytics.


Requirements

Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals.
Strong SQL, NoSQL, data manipulation, analytical thinking, and debugging ability.
Practical understanding of LLMs and Generative AI.
Working knowledge of prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, vector search, and semantic search.
Experience with agentic AI concepts such as tool use, function calling, and multi-step workflows.
Ability to build and consume REST APIs.
A production mindset: maintainable systems, reliable outputs, and sensible trade-offs around latency and cost.
Genuine interest in football and sports.


Nice to Have

Experience with NLP, Transformers, or multimodal AI.
LLM fine-tuning, LoRA/PEFT, structured outputs, or AI agents.
LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks.
Vector databases such as Pinecone or similar.
FastAPI, Django, or Flask.
Docker and cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Familiarity with football analytics metrics such as xG, xA, xT, PPDA, or VAEP.
